author: National Geographic
description:
Join Antoni Porowski as he goes beyond the guidebooks to unlock the vibrant heart of Mexico City (CDMX) in this full episode of Best of the World with Antoni Porowski from National Geographic. Antoni explores Mexico City’s most remarkable travel experiences, from Michelin-starred cuisine to fight nights at the cathedral of the lucha libre. He learns how heirloom corn can transform a taco, discovers bold architecture, visits the haunting Isla de las Muñecas (Island of the Dolls), glides through Xochimilco’s ancient waterways, and joins a vibrant folk-art parade featuring fantastical creatures, experiencing firsthand why Mexico City is one of the world’s best travel destinations.
